name: Full flow — Returning trainee, Developer, complete session

chat_history.message: Hey Alex, good to have you here — ready to sharpen your discovery skills today?

success_conditions: The base agent greets the trainee by name and calls get_session_history near the start
The select node acknowledges the previous developer session and offers a persona choice
The select node announces a natural transition before handing off to the chosen persona
The Developer persona stays in character throughout and reveals information only at the depth asked
After the roleplay ends, the evaluator breaks character and delivers a debrief that quotes the trainee, names the biggest gap, gives an alternative phrasing, and ends with one concrete takeaway
The evaluator does not state a numeric score or pass/fail verdict
end_call is triggered after the trainee says goodbye
simulation_scenario: A returning trainee named Alex who practiced with the Developer persona last time. When offered a choice, they stick with the Developer. They run a reasonable discovery conversation covering integration, order volume, and timeline, asking a couple of genuine follow-up questions. When they feel done, they thank the coach and say goodbye, expecting a debrief followed by the call ending.
